# theme-helper-functions spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - helper functions after `functions.php` split
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 5 - "functions.php split"

---

## Purpose

Confirm that the theme's public helper surface still works after `functions.php` is split
into `functions-post.php`, `functions-nav.php`, `functions-media.php`,
`functions-comments.php`, `functions-i18n.php`. Every aggregator-re-exported name must
remain callable: navigation menu, previous/next post, topic/tag links, sidebar widgets,
site title, and archive index.

---

## URLs

| Route | Expected |
|-------|----------|
| `/` | 200, nav menu + sidebar widgets render |
| `/?p=11` | 200, `.posts-nav` prev/next + `.post-tags` + category link |
| `/archives` | 200, archive index lists years/months |
| `/privacy` | 200, privacy policy renders |
| `/?cat=200` | 200, category listing with sidebar categories |

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` seeded with >= 2 published posts (so prev/next nav exists), topic 200
  active, tag `e2e-tag`, a privacy policy row, archive months from posts.
- Active theme `blog`.

---

## User Actions

- Load home; expand primary nav; click each nav item and confirm it navigates to a 200 page.
- Open a single post and confirm previous/next links exist and point to valid posts.
- Click a category in the sidebar; confirm the category listing loads.
- Open `/archives` and confirm the index lists at least one year with months.
- Open `/privacy` and confirm localized privacy content renders.

---

## Expected Behaviour

- `<nav id="navbar-menu">` contains menu items from `tbl_menu` public items, sorted.
- `.posts-nav` on a single post has previous/next anchors to real posts (not `#`).
- `.post-tags` renders tag links to `/?tag=...`.
- Sidebar shows categories, archives, latest posts, tags, and the search form.
- `/archives` groups archives by year (e.g. a `h2`/year header with month links).
- All helper functions referenced by templates exist (no "Call to undefined function"
  fatal in the rendered output).

---

## Validation Rules

- Assert no "Call to undefined function" / "Fatal error" text on any page body.
- `locator('#navbar-menu a')` count >= 1 and each link navigates (href not `#`).
- On single post, `locator('.posts-nav a')` count >= 1 and hrefs contain `?p=`.
- `/archives` contains a link matching `/?a=YYYYMM`.

---

## UI Components

- `header.php`: `#navbar-menu`, language switcher.
- `single.php`: `.posts-nav`, `.post-tags`.
- `sidebar.php`: widgets (search, latest, categories, archives, tags).
- `archives.php`: year groups + month links.

---

## Accessibility

- Nav has `aria-label`; dropdown toggles keyboard-operable.
- Archive links have readable month/year text.

---

## Console

- No JS errors from nav/scroll scripts.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- No undefined-function fatals on home, single, category, archives, privacy.
- Nav menu renders items and links navigate.

High:
- Single post shows working prev/next and tag links.
- Sidebar category click loads the category page.

Medium:
- Archive index lists years/months.

Regression:
- All helper names still callable after the split.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-helper-functions.spec.js`. Scan every rendered page for the literal
strings "Call to undefined function" and "Fatal error". Use `#navbar-menu a`, `.posts-nav a`,
`.post-tags a`. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
